Flow.description: Screen flow launched from an Opportunity record to add or remove an Opportunity Team Member. Best-in-class rebuild of "Opportunity Team: Create/Remove Team Member Screenflow" (legacy API name Create_Opportunity_Contacts). Runs in System Mode With Sharing. Fault connectors route every DML/Get to a single error screen; guardrails block duplicate members, adding the Opportunity owner, and confirm self-removal; CED/SDR are single-holder roles synced to Opportunity fields; CS Contact members are rolled up into Opportunity.CS_Contact__c.

assignments.name: asg_AppendCsContact
assignments.label: Append CS Contact Name
assignments.description: Accumulates each CS Contact team member name into a semicolon-delimited string. Assignment only - no DML/SOQL inside the loop, so it is bulk-safe.

value.stringValue: Opportunity Team: Create/Remove Team Member Screenflow

decisions.name: dec_AddOrRemove
decisions.label: Add or Remove?
decisions.description: Routes to the Add path or the Remove path based on the user's choice on the first screen.

decisions.name: dec_CedExists
decisions.label: CED Already Assigned?
decisions.description: Client Engagement Director is a single-holder role. If one already exists on the Opportunity, block and ask the user to remove it first.

decisions.name: dec_ClosedWonGate
decisions.label: Closed Won Gate
decisions.description: Team changes are restricted on Closed Won Opportunities for non-admins. System Administrators bypass the gate.

decisions.name: dec_IsDuplicate
decisions.label: Already a Team Member?
decisions.description: Idempotency guard: if the selected user already has an OpportunityTeamMember record on this Opportunity, block with a friendly message instead of hitting the unique-key DML error.

decisions.name: dec_IsOwner
decisions.label: Is Selected User the Owner?
decisions.description: The Opportunity owner is implicitly on the team and cannot be added as an OpportunityTeamMember (Salesforce rejects it). Block with a clear message.

decisions.name: dec_IsSelfRemoval
decisions.label: Removing Yourself?
decisions.description: If the user is about to remove their own team membership (and may lose access), show a confirmation screen first.

decisions.name: dec_RemovedCedMatch
decisions.label: Removed the Synced CED?
decisions.description: If the removed member was the user currently stamped on Opportunity.Client_Engagement_Director__c, clear that field to keep it in sync.

decisions.name: dec_RemovedSdrMatch
decisions.label: Removed the Synced SDR?
decisions.description: If the removed member was the user currently stamped on Opportunity.Sales_Development_Representative__c, clear that field to keep it in sync.

decisions.name: dec_RoleOnAdd
decisions.label: Role on Add
decisions.description: Branches the add path by role: CED and SDR are single-holder roles synced to Opportunity fields; all other roles (incl. CS Contact) take the default create path.

decisions.name: dec_RoleOnRemove
decisions.label: Role on Remove
decisions.description: Branches the remove path by the removed member's role so the synced Opportunity field can be cleared when appropriate.

decisions.name: dec_SdrExists
decisions.label: SDR Already Assigned?
decisions.description: Sales Development Representative is a single-holder role. If one already exists on the Opportunity, block and ask the user to remove it first.

Flow.label: Opportunity Team: Manage Team Member

loops.name: loop_CsContacts
loops.label: For Each CS Contact
loops.description: Iterates CS Contact team members to rebuild the rollup string. Contains no DML/SOQL - bulk-safe.

recordCreates.name: create_MemberCED
recordCreates.label: Create Team Member (CED)
recordCreates.description: Creates the OpportunityTeamMember for the Client Engagement Director role.

recordCreates.name: create_MemberOther
recordCreates.label: Create Team Member (Other)
recordCreates.description: Creates the OpportunityTeamMember for CS Contact and any non-single-holder role, then rebuilds the CS Contact rollup.

recordCreates.name: create_MemberSDR
recordCreates.label: Create Team Member (SDR)
recordCreates.description: Creates the OpportunityTeamMember for the Sales Development Representative role.

recordDeletes.name: del_Member
recordDeletes.label: Delete Selected Team Member
recordDeletes.description: Deletes the OpportunityTeamMember selected in the datatable.

recordLookups.name: get_CedHolder
recordLookups.label: Get Existing CED
recordLookups.description: Finds an existing Client Engagement Director team member on this Opportunity (single-holder check).

recordLookups.name: get_CsContactMembers
recordLookups.label: Get CS Contact Members
recordLookups.description: Retrieves all CS Contact team members on this Opportunity to rebuild the CS_Contact__c rollup. Shared convergence point for the add-other and all remove paths.

recordLookups.name: get_ExistingMemberForUser
recordLookups.label: Get Existing Member for User
recordLookups.description: Per-user duplicate guard: looks for an existing OpportunityTeamMember for the selected user on this Opportunity.

recordLookups.name: get_Opportunity
recordLookups.label: Get Opportunity
recordLookups.description: Loads the Opportunity (StageName, OwnerId, and the CED/SDR sync fields) for gating and matching.

recordLookups.name: get_RenewalOpp
recordLookups.label: Get Renewal Opportunity
recordLookups.description: Lazily looks up the renewal Opportunity (Previous_Opportunity__c = this record) only when showing the Closed Won message.

recordLookups.name: get_SdrHolder
recordLookups.label: Get Existing SDR
recordLookups.description: Finds an existing Sales Development Representative team member on this Opportunity (single-holder check).

recordLookups.name: get_TeamForRemoval
recordLookups.label: Get Team for Removal
recordLookups.description: Retrieves all OpportunityTeamMember records on this Opportunity to populate the removal datatable.

recordUpdates.name: upd_OppCed
recordUpdates.label: Stamp CED on Opportunity
recordUpdates.description: Sets Opportunity.Client_Engagement_Director__c to the newly added user. Matches by Id.

recordUpdates.name: upd_OppClearCed
recordUpdates.label: Clear CED on Opportunity
recordUpdates.description: Clears Opportunity.Client_Engagement_Director__c when the removed member was the synced CED. Matches by Id.

recordUpdates.name: upd_OppClearSdr
recordUpdates.label: Clear SDR on Opportunity
recordUpdates.description: Clears Opportunity.Sales_Development_Representative__c when the removed member was the synced SDR. Matches by Id.

recordUpdates.name: upd_OppCsContact
recordUpdates.label: Update CS Contact Rollup
recordUpdates.description: Writes the rebuilt, de-duplicated CS Contact name list (trailing separator trimmed) to Opportunity.CS_Contact__c. Matches by Id.

recordUpdates.name: upd_OppSdr
recordUpdates.label: Stamp SDR on Opportunity
recordUpdates.description: Sets Opportunity.Sales_Development_Representative__c to the newly added user. Matches by Id.
